title: A Generalized McDiarmid Inequality: Sample Reuse and Non-Uniform Unbounded Differences
abstract: arXiv:2610.17159v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a novel generalization of McDiarmid's concentration inequality and use it to obtain a uniform law of large numbers result and error bounds on stochastic optimization problems which simultaneously incorporate two key features: 1) They capture the benefit of training sample reuse in algorithms that also employ easily-sampled auxiliary random variables. 2) They allow for one-component mean-difference bounding functions which are both unbounded in the component of interest and have non-uniform dependence on another component. We demonstrate the utility of our method by deriving concentration inequalities for score-based generative modeling. This application naturally leverages both key features of our new tools: 1) It utilizes auxiliary Gaussian random variables in conjunction with the training samples; accounting for training sample reuse results in tighter error bounds by effectively integrating out the dependence on the auxilia

translated_title: 广义McDiarmid不等式：样本复用与非均匀无界差分
translated_abstract: 我们开发了McDiarmid集中不等式的一种新颖推广形式，并利用它得到了一致大数定律结果以及随机优化问题的误差界，这些结果同时包含两个关键特征：1）它们捕捉了在同时使用易于采样的辅助随机变量的算法中训练样本复用所带来的好处；2）它们允许单分量均值差分界定函数在感兴趣的分量上无界，同时对另一个分量具有非均匀依赖性。我们通过为基于分数的生成模型推导集中不等式来展示我们方法的实用性。这一应用自然地利用了我们新工具的两个关键特征：1）它将辅助高斯随机变量与训练样本结合使用；考虑训练样本复用可以通过有效积分消除对辅助变量的依赖，从而得到更紧的误差界。
tldr: 本文提出了McDiarmid不等式的一种新颖广义形式，能够同时刻画训练样本复用的收益并处理无界且非均匀依赖的差分函数，并将其应用于基于分数的生成模型以获得更紧的误差界。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a novel generalization of McDiarmid's concentration inequality that simultaneously captures the benefit of training sample reuse and accommodates unbounded, non-uniformly dependent difference functions, and applies it to derive tighter error bounds for score-based generative modeling.
